facts.anchor: It was a long day, but finally, just after I spotted Roddie walking by the window toward the antique store, Gail texted again. Georgia is in recovery. The surgeon is happy with how it went.
facts.fact: Gail 短信：Georgia 已进恢复室、医生满意、麻药明早退——Meg 一整天紧绷的弦松下来。

facts.anchor: I deflated with relief, only then realizing how much tension I’d been holding all day.
facts.fact: 她提前打烊去古董店接 Roddie；Zak 抬头给了一个让她脚趾发麻的同情眼神。

facts.anchor: I locked up a few minutes early and walked into Twice Is Nice to get Roddie.
facts.fact: 他问消息，Meg 报「在恢复，接下来是愈合与物理治疗」。

facts.anchor: Zak looked up from tightening some hardware on a cabinet. He gave me a compassionate look that made my toes curl.
facts.fact: Roddie 在帮 Dale 摆蕾丝垫与玻璃杯托。

facts.anchor: “Any news?” he asked. He’d dropped in a few times today, but I’d had a surprisingly busy day as several of Georgia’s friends had come by the shop to ask about her.
facts.fact: Georgia 的朋友们今天来店里打听情况——忙碌反而成了 Meg 的分心。

facts.anchor: He nodded and headed toward the back of the shop.
facts.fact: 她的心里话：Georgia 会回到她的美好生活，Meg 只是帮她守住梦想——「那是她的梦想，不是我的」。
